title: Floor Core - A
texts: A simple core workout which requires nothing but floor space

Twist crunches - Starting in an extended position, touch the opposite elbow to knee alternating sides at a steady pace. Complete 5 reps total which equates to 8 knee and elbow touches on both sides. That's 16 movements total. 

Dish tuck - Try to extend the body as much as possible. Complete 8 reps per set.

Superman - Start in plank before extending your hands and feet as far apart as possible on alternating sides in turn. Complete 8 reps total which equates to 8 reaches on both sides. That's 16 movements total. 

Rest 1 minute between sets and exercises.

You may add ankle and/or wrist weights to increase the intensity, or you may reduce the rest between sets or add reps. Reduce the volume of reps to decrease the intensity.
